env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^nums:123 <nil>$'
stdout '^words:ab <nil>$'
stdout '^exact-int$'
stdout '^tilde-int$'
stdout '^other$'
stdout '^keep: <nil>$'
stdout '^sw-nums:123 <nil>$'
stdout '^sw-words:abS <nil>$'
stdout '^sw-point:S <nil>$'
stdout '^sw-keep: <nil>$'
 cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch.lgo n/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_order.lgo o/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nomatch.lgo k/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_jumps.lgo b/main.lgo

# The run fixtures of the run-time form print the same lines when ejected:
# a case chosen by the type argument alone, an interface type argument,
# shared storage for a rebound slice, map and pointer, an interface method
# run on the value, first match, no match, and a break, continue or labeled
# jump that sits inside or leaves a case.
cd n
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch.out
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch.out
cd ../..

cd o
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_order.out
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_order.out
cd ../..

cd k
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nomatch.out
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nomatch.out
cd ../..

cd b
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_jumps.out
logos eject -o out
cd out

cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectconstswitch

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
)

func EncodeSlice[T any](buf []byte, items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		for _, v := range items {
			buf = strconv.AppendInt(buf, v, 10)
		}
		return buf, nil
	case io.WriterTo:
		var b bytes.Buffer
		for _, v := range items {
			v.WriteTo(&b)?
		}
		return append(buf, b.Bytes()...), nil
	}
	return buf, nil
}

type Word struct {
	S string
}

func (w Word) WriteTo(dst io.Writer) (int64, error) {
	n, err := dst.Write([]byte(w.S))
	return int64(n), err
}

type UserID int

func describe[T any](v T) string {
	const switch T {
	case int:
		return "exact-int"
	case ~int:
		return "tilde-int"
	}
	return "other"
}

func show(b []byte, err error) {
	fmt.Printf("%s %v\n", b, err)
}

func main() {
	show(EncodeSlice([]byte("nums:"), []int64{1, 2, 3}))
	show(EncodeSlice([]byte("words:"), []Word{{"a"}, {"b"}}))
	fmt.Println(describe(3))
	fmt.Println(describe(UserID(3)))
	fmt.Println(describe("s"))
	show(EncodeOrKeep([]byte("keep:"), []string{"x", "y"}))
	show(EncodeSwitch([]byte("sw-nums:"), []int64{1, 2, 3}))
	show(EncodeSwitch([]byte("sw-words:"), []Word{{"a"}, {"b"}}))
	show(EncodeSwitch([]byte("sw-point:"), []Point{{1, 2}}))
	show(EncodeSwitch([]byte("sw-keep:"), []string{"x", "y"}))
}

func EncodeOrKeep[T any](buf []byte, items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		for _, v := range items {
			buf = strconv.AppendInt(buf, v, 10)
		}
		return buf, nil
	case io.WriterTo:
		var b bytes.Buffer
		for _, v := range items {
			v.WriteTo(&b)?
		}
		return append(buf, b.Bytes()...), nil
	}
	return buf, nil
}

func EncodeSwitch[T any](buf []byte, items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		for _, v := range items {
			buf = strconv.AppendInt(buf, v, 10)
		}
	case io.WriterTo:
		var b bytes.Buffer
		for _, v := range items {
			v.WriteTo(&b)?
		}
		buf = append(buf, b.Bytes()...)
	}
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		buf = append(buf, 'S')
	}
	return buf, nil
}

type Point struct {
	X int
	Y int
}
